pdf_qa.reason: /upload/pdf correctly extracts and summarizes text via one-off llm_client chat_completion, but does NOT inject the document text into the agent's SqliteSaver memory for follow-up queries. Follow-up queries complain about missing context.

ui_badges.action: Corrected hardcoded AIR-GAP STATUS in LeftRail.tsx to dynamically reflect MONITOR_UNAVAILABLE (UNVERIFIED [No PCAP]).

known_limitations_for_demo: Browser subagent validation failed due to Gemini API rate limits (503 Service Unavailable), so API-level validation was performed simulating exact UI requests.
UI lacks a frontend file upload button for images/PDFs. The backend supports it, but the UI must either be manually bypassed or updated before the demo.
Vision cold-start takes up to 80s locally on test hardware.
PDF QA is a one-shot summarizer; it does not persist the PDF to the LangGraph vector store.
